dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetric, linear reduction in lateral width from the mid-section toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight asymmetrical indentation on the left lateral margin relative to the mid-body axis.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white anterior region transitioning to a light-grey median tone in the posterior half.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High-frequency distribution of irregular, high-intensity white patches concentrated in the mid-dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the solid white anterior and the mottled grey mid-section.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One high-contrast circular dark point in the anterior region; one dark longitudinal linear mark on the posterior dorsal axis.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A single longitudinal topological groove causing a shadow-like contrast disruption along the posterior central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct dark-pigmented longitudinal linear mark or scar located on the posterior dorsal midline.
